_doc: Hard performance budgets for the procedural vehicle profile. Enforced by validate_asset.mjs (FAIL when exceeded). Derived from the measured build in REPORT.md with ~10% headroom; tighten as the game's host budget is measured (G-PERF). These are asset budgets, never player caps.

dent_spacing_m._note: max MEAN edge length of dentable paint triangles; a dent of radius r needs ~r/3 spacing to read
